comment: HS 100630 (semi-milled or wholly milled rice, whether or not polished or glazed) is CORROBORATED as one real line: the site explicitly lists 'Rice & Lentils' and names rice among its export products. But it is only one of ~18 declared product families, so the declaration is materially incomplete — match_status = partial, not exact. Per project rule 3 the company is NOT rejected for the HS gap; the code is kept and the list is corrected/expanded to the actual range above. Industry label 'Продукты питания и FMCG' is broadly right but understates the scope: the site also sells cosmetics, herbal/ayurvedic products, pooja/religious festival items and beverages, i.e. non-food FMCG and religious-goods lines that are missing from the declaration entirely. Trader signs: 1500+ SKUs across unrelated categories, no factory/plant details, no certifications shown beyond a claim of 'adhering to USDA, AQIS, CFIA and EU guidelines', personal Gmail as the only contact. All product claims are 'заявлено, не подтверждено' — no customs line, invoice, B/L or shipment record was checked or found in this pass, and no product-level catalogue exists to verify against. Note: the site's own text is the only source used here; registry/revenue/customs research was out of scope for this role.
